description: This file implements a class and functions to remove fall-through cases from switch statements in an abstract syntax tree (AST) for shader code, ensuring that each switch case ends with a break or return to prevent fall-through behavior.

classes.name: RemoveSwitchFallThroughTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to remove fall-through cases in switch statements, ensuring each case ends with a break.

methods.name: removeFallThrough
methods.description: Static method that initiates the traversal to remove fall-through from a given statement list.

methods.name: RemoveSwitchFallThroughTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with the statement list and diagnostics.

methods.name: visitConstantUnion
methods.description: Handles constant union nodes; marked as unreachable in this context.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Handles binary operation nodes during traversal.

methods.name: visitUnary
methods.description: Handles unary operation nodes during traversal.

methods.name: visitTernary
methods.description: Handles ternary operation nodes during traversal.

methods.name: visitBranch
methods.description: Handles branch nodes (break, continue, return) during traversal.

methods.name: outputSequence
methods.description: Outputs a sequence of AST nodes starting from a specified index.

methods.name: handlePreviousCase
methods.description: Processes the previous case, managing fall-through logic and warnings.
